Aurora Lerena), a son of Natalia LERENA (m. Manuel Vaquero) and so her first cousin. The two phantom rows are merged away.

what: *** GIL LERENA DIED ON 2 OCTOBER 1883, AT SIXTY-FOUR, AND HIS SON FERMIN DECLARED IT ***
the source: San Jose Death Records 1879-1894, image 76 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q9Y3-G) and Santisima Trinidad Religious Death Records 1873-1888, image 161 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23W1-F) - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPTS ***
result: The civil act of 2 October 1883 records at Tala de Carreta Quemada the death of Don Gil Lerena, sixty-four, husband of Dona Anastasia Santa Cruz, fifty-eight, declared by his son Fermin Lerena, thirty, married, a stockbreeder who could not sign; the parish buries him on 3 October.
what was already known: Gil and Anastasia were known from the burial of their son Faustino in 1866 and from the baptism of their grandson Faustino in 1877; nothing dated Gil or told where he lived.
what the act says: Gil LERENA (m. Anastasia Santa Cruz) died at about sixty-four on 2 October 1883, leaving Anastasia SANTA CRUZ (m. Gil Lerena) a widow at fifty-eight and his son Fermin LERENA (of Trinidad) as the declarant; Faustino LERENA (son of Gil, buried 1866)'s burial certificate was registered at Montevideo in 1895.

what: *** ALEJANDRO LERENA THE ELDER DIED ON 1 APRIL 1874 AT TRINIDAD, A WIDOWER ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, image 29 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WH-H) - burial of 2 April 1874, no. 40 - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'al cadaver de Dn. Alejandro Lerena, oriental, de sesenta y cinco anos de edad, viudo de la finada Da. Margarita Fernandez. Murio ayer de un ataque' - first-class funeral, with the cross.
what was already known: Alejandro Lerena was known as the father of the nine children from the dispensation of 1853 and the baptisms, alive at Trinidad in August 1861; Margarita Fernandez's burial of 21 December 1869 was only 'very likely' hers.
what the act says: He died of a stroke on 1 April 1874 at about sixty-five, and the act calls Margarita Fernandez 'la finada' - so the burial of 1869 is hers on a second ground, and the elder had been a widower for four years.

what: *** THREE CHILDREN OF RAMON FERNANDEZ AND MARIA LERENA DIED IN 1873 ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, images 14, 17 and 21 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WZ-F, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WH-3, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WZ-G) - burials of 6 May, 27 May and 11 August 1873 - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'Modesta Fernandez, de siete anos de edad ... hija legitima de Ramon y de Maria Serena'; 'Maria Fernandez, de once anos ... hija legitima de Ramon y de Maria Serena'; 'Maria de los Reyes Fernandez, de catorce meses, hija legitima'.
what was already known: Six children of the household were known by their baptisms, from 1855 to 1866, with nothing said of what became of them.
what the act says: Modesta Carmelita (nine, though the clerk wrote seven) and Maria Josefa del Carmen (eleven) died of sores in May 1873, and a child of fourteen months, Maria de los Reyes, in August - the last child of the couple known; the clerk wrote Serena for Lerena throughout.

what: *** RAMON INOCENCIO LERENA DIED ON 19 DECEMBER 1887, AND VITALINO LERENA ON 14 MAY 1883 ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, images 199 and 155 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WY-H, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WH-Q) - burials of 20 December 1887 (no. 165) and 15 May 1883 (no. 46) - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'Ramon Lerena, que fallecio ayer a la edad de cuarenta y ocho anos, hijo legitimo de Alejandro y de Margarita Fernandez'; 'don Vitalino Lerena, oriental, casado con dona Andrea Echeverre. Fallecio ayer, a los cuarenta y dos anos'.
what was already known: Ramon Inocencio was known only from his baptism of 1838; Vitalino from his children's baptisms and the death act of his son, which said he was dead by 1898.
what the act says: Vitalino died in May 1883 leaving Andrea Echeverre a widow; Ramon, named for the father of Alejandro the elder, died in December 1887 at forty-eight with his parents named and no wife.

what: *** MAURICIO LERENA OF COLLA DIED ON 11 NOVEMBER 1879 AND HIS WIDOW WAS CASIMIRA MONTANO ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, image 107 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WW-G) - burial of 12 November 1879, no. 123 - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'al cadaver de Don Mauricio Lerena, oriental, casado con Dona Casimira Montana. Fallecio ayer a los setenta y dos anos de edad'.
what was already known: Mauricio, who married at San Jose in 1837, was held as 'the patriarch' with no death; his widow was found in 1895.
what the act says: He died at Trinidad on 11 November 1879 at seventy-two; the Mauricio of Trinidad who stood godfather with Petrona Aguilar in 1866 and the Mauricio of 1886 were therefore other men or this man's sons.

what: *** MARGARITA LERENA, WIFE OF LUIS SENA, DIED ON 5 SEPTEMBER 1880; JUANA MARIA LERENA, DAUGHTER OF FERMIN, ON 13 SEPTEMBER 1881; CLARA LERENA ON 16 AUGUST 1886 ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, images 118, 130 and 186 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WW-L, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23W7-P, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-234M-Z) - burials of 6 September 1880 (no. 88), 14 September 1881 and 17 August 1886 - the first and third *** PLATE READ ***, the second *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT ***
result: 'dona Margarita Lerena, oriental, casada con don Luis Sena ... a los treinta y cuatro anos'; 'doña Juana Maria Serena, soltera, hija legitima de don Fermin de dona Paulina Barragan Valle ... a los dos anos'; 'Clara Lerena ... ochenta y un anos, oriental, viuda de Francisco Fernandez'.
what was already known: Juana Maria was held as 'almost certainly' Fermin's child on an index; Clara was the wife of Francisco Fernandez Alvarez known from the baptisms of 1828-1862.
what the act says: Clara Lerena died a widow of eighty-one in 1886, Juana Maria Lerena at two in 1881 - her parents named - and a Margarita Lerena, whose husband Luis Sena is new to this archive, in 1880 at thirty-four.

what: *** CASIMIRA PELAEZ, WIDOW OF BERNABE LERENA, DIED ON 31 OCTOBER 1913 AT SEVENTY-THREE, LEAVING TWELVE CHILDREN ***
the source: Flores, Death Records 1888-1917 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q7PZ), image 292 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q64H) - civil act no. 5 of 6 November 1913, La Cordobesa - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'ha fallecido Casimira Pelaez de Lerena ... de setenta y tres anos ... hija legitima de Don Juan Pelaez y de Dona Antonina Lerena ... la finada era viuda de Don Bernabe Lerena y deja de sucesion doce hijos y son: [the twelve are named]' - the three new to this archive are Socorro LERENA Pelaez (named 1913), Eduvijes LERENA Pelaez (named 1913) and Isidro LERENA Pelaez (named 1913).
what was already known: Casimira was known as Bernabe's wife and the mother of the children found by their baptisms and the births of grandchildren; she was last seen alive at her mother's death in July 1911.
what the act says: She died at Cerro Colorado, a widow, on 31 October 1913; Bernabe was therefore dead by then, having been alive in April 1909; three of the twelve children are new to this archive and have rows of their own.

what: *** THREE LERENA CHILDREN OF CHAMANGA DIED YOUNG, 1890-1909 ***
the source: Flores, Death Records 1888-1917 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q7PZ), images 35, 208 and 248 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-QJ2L, 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q767, 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-QC7R) - civil acts of October 1890, 11 November 1905 and 14 January 1909 - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPTS ***
result: Celestino LERENA Harrison (b. 1890, d. 1890), 'de tres meses y veintidos dias ... hijo legitimo de don Pio C. [Lerena] y de dona Bernardina Harrison ... abuelos paternos don Alejandro F. Lerena y dona Severa Fernandez'; Linda Maria LERENA Harrison (b. 1905, d. 1905), 'hija legitima de Don Pio C. [Lerena] y de Dona Bernardina Harrison'; Flora LERENA Harrison (b. c.1887, d. 1909), 'de veintiun anos ... hija legitima de Don Venancio [Lerena] y de Dona Venancia Harrison'.
what was already known: Pio and Venancio were known as sons of Alejandro the younger and Severa Fernandez; Venancio's wife had been read 'Venancia Arisen' on an index and doubted.
what the act says: The first two were children of Pio C. LERENA and Bernardina HARRISON (m. Pio C. Lerena 1884), the third of Venancio LERENA Fernandez (m. 1885) and Venancia HARRISON (m. Venancio Lerena 1885) - the index's 'Arisen' was a Harrison, the same surname as his brother's wife.

what: *** GABINO LERENA DIED ON 9 FEBRUARY 1890 AT CHAMANGA, A SON OF RAMON LERENA AND MARIA GONZALEZ, AND HIS WIFE ON 9 JUNE 1887 ***
the source: Flores, Death Records 1888-1917 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-Q7PZ), image 26 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-QC5T) - civil act no. 2 of 9 February 1890 - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT ***; and Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, image 192 (ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WB-V) - burial of 10 June 1887 - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'ha fallecido Don Gabino Lerena, de ... ochenta y tres anos de edad, de estado casado viudo ... el finado era hijo legitimo de Don Ramon Lerena y de dona Maria Gonzalez, ambos fallecidos ... el primer declarante es sobrino del extinto'; and 'Anastasia Moyano que fallecio ayer a la edad de sesenta y cuatro anos, casada con Gabino Lerena'.
what was already known: Gabino of Flores was a name on a tree and an indexed marriage with no date, said to be a son of Ramon Llerena; nothing dated him or named his wife.
what the act says: He died of exhaustion at Chamanga on 9 February 1890 at about eighty-three, a widower, three years after Anastasia Moyano; the act names Ramon Lerena and Maria Gonzalez as his parents, so he is a third brother of Alejandro the elder and Mauricio.

what: *** MANUEL FERNANDEZ ALVAREZ DIED ON 21 NOVEMBER 1878 AND HIS WIDOW MARIA DE LOS REYES GONZALEZ ON 20 DECEMBER 1884 ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records January 1873 - July 1888, images 90 and 174 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WH-B, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23W1-J) - burials of 21 November 1878 (no. 117) and 21 December 1884 - *** PLATE READ ***
result: 'al cadaver de Don Manuel Fernandez y Alvarez, oriental, casado con Dona Maria Reyes Gonzalez. Fallecio hoy, a la edad de setenta y cuatro anos'; 'Dona Maria de los Reyes Gonzalez. Fallecio ayer a los setenta y ocho anos de edad, viuda de Don Manuel Fernandez'.
what was already known: Manuel and Maria de los Reyes were known from the dispensations of 1854 and 1855 as the parents of Serapio and Severa Fernandez, with no dates of death.
what the act says: Manuel died on 21 November 1878 at seventy-four, a third-class funeral with the high cross; his widow outlived him by six years, to seventy-eight.

what: *** ANASTASIA SANTA CRUZ, WIDOW OF GIL LERENA, DIED ON 19 SEPTEMBER 1895 AT EIGHTY-FIVE; MARIA LERENA'S AND GABINO'S PARISH BURIALS ***
the source: Santisima Trinidad, Religious Death Records August 1888 - May 1898 (52 images, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WB-G), images 41, 25-26 and 13 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23W5-V, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WR-W, 3:1:3Q9M-CS27-23WY-Y) - burials of 20 September 1895, 4 May 1892 and 10 February 1890 - the first *** PLATE READ ***, the second plate read at its close, the third *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPT ***
result: 'Anastasia Santa Cruz que fallecio ayer a la edad de ochenta y cinco anos, oriental, viuda de Gil Llerena'; 'Maria Serena ... de sesenta y cuatro anos, oriental, viuda de Ramon Fernandez'; 'Gabino Lerena ... ochenta anos, viudo de Anastasia Moyano'.
what was already known: Anastasia Santa Cruz was known only as a widow of fifty-eight in her husband's death act of 1883; Maria Lerena's civil death and Gabino's civil death were known, not their burials.
what the act says: Anastasia lived to September 1895; her age of 1883 and her age of 1895 are the same digits reversed, and neither is settled here.

what: *** FRANCISCO FERNANDEZ, SON OF CLARA LERENA, DIED ON 18 MARCH 1894 AT SIXTY-FIVE; AND TWO CHILDREN OF MANUEL VAQUERO, 1893 AND 1896 ***
the source: Trinidad, Flores, Death Records 1892-1896 (389 images, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W77S-Y), images 159, 130 and 318 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W73J-7, 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W7Q5-K, 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W77S-Y) - civil acts no. 48 of 19 March 1894 (*** PLATE READ ***), no. 124 of 20 December 1893 and no. 32 of 23 February 1896 (*** MACHINE TRANSCRIPTS ***)
result: 'ha fallecido Francisco Fernandez ... de sesenta y cinco anos ... hijo legitimo de Don Francisco Fernandez y de Dona Clara Lerena, fallecidos'; 'Dalmira Vaquero ... un ano ... hija legitima de Don Manuel Vaquero y de Dona Aurora Lerena'; 'Elmira Vaquero ... veinte meses ... Abuelos paternos: Manuel Vaquero y Natalia Lerena; maternos: Alejandro F. Lerena y Severa Fernandez'.
what was already known: Pedro Francisco Fernandez, born 1828 to Clara Lerena, was known only from his baptism; Aurora Lerena and Manuel Vaquero were known from their other children.
what the act says: A Francisco Fernandez of exactly the right age, son of Clara Lerena, died of tuberculosis of the larynx at Trinidad on 18 March 1894 - very probably Pedro Francisco; and Aurora and Manuel Vaquero lost a daughter in December 1893 and another in February 1896.

what: *** FLORA VAQUERO DIED ON 30 JANUARY 1897 AND DOLORES CARMEN GONZALEZ ON 2 JUNE 1898, AND ESTEFANIA LERENA WAS A LIVING WIDOW IN 1898 ***
the source: Trinidad, Flores, Death Records 1897-1898 (171 images, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W79K-K), images 17 and 125 (arks 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W79K-K, 3:1:3Q9M-CS24-W79J-R) - civil acts of 30 January 1897 and no. 59 of 2 June 1898 - *** MACHINE TRANSCRIPTS ***
result: 'ha fallecido Flora Vaquero ... de once meses ... hija legitima de Don Manuel Vaquero ... y de Dona Aurora Lerena'; 'Dolores Carmen Gonzalez ... Abuelos paternos: Don Servando J. Gonzalez - fallecido, y de dona Estefania Lerena ... de sesenta y cuatro anos, viuda ... domiciliada en esta Villa'.
what was already known: Estefania Lerena was last seen at her granddaughter's baptism; Aurora Lerena's children were known by two infant deaths and a survivor.
what the act says: Aurora Lerena and Manuel Vaquero lost a third daughter, Flora, at eleven months; and Estefania Lerena was living at Trinidad on 2 June 1898, a widow, with her son Francisco C. Gonzalez, a procurador, losing a baby of three weeks.
